nodes.procedure: The operations of oil removal and oxide layer removal were conducted, as presented in previous work.

nodes.name: Chemical plating
nodes.procedure: The chemical plating solution containing 15 g per L FeSO4·7H2O, 15 g per L NiSO4·6H2O, 150 g per L NaH2PO2·H2O, 20 g per L Na2SO4, 30 g per L H3BO3 and 60 g per L Na3C6H5O7·2H2O was used. NaOH was used to modulate pH to 10. Ni foam was immersed in the chemical plating solution at 80 °C for 1 h.

nodes.name: Annealing crystallization
nodes.procedure: To obtain clean crystalline (Ni1-xFex)3P, the product of chemical plating was annealed at 400 °C for 4 h in an Ar environment and then at 600 °C for 35 min in H2 and Ar environments.

nodes.name: Superaerophobic NiFe-OH-P layer formation
nodes.procedure: The superaerophobic heterostructure of (Ni1-xFex)3P/NiFe-OH-P was synthesized by etching (Ni1-xFex)3P in 2.5 M KOH at 80 °C for 5 h. Under high concentration and high temperature, the reactions rate would be extremely high, which would boost growth rate of the NiFe–OH–P to form a superaerophobic surface.
nodes.source_text: The superaerophobic heterostructure of (Ni1-xFex)3P/NiFe-OH was synthesized by etching (Ni1-xFex)3P in 2.5 M KOH at 80 °C for 5 h.

nodes.name: Surface etching
nodes.procedure: In order to achieve the surface etching sample, the tested electrode was immersed in 50 g per L citric acid solution for 10 min at 80 °C. Ammonia water was used to modulate pH to 3.5.
nodes.source_text: the tested electrode was immersed in 50 g per L citric acid solution for 10 min at 80 °C. Ammonia water was used to modulate pH to 3.5.

nodes.description: OER activity measurement of superaerophobic heterostructure
nodes.source_text: The reverse scan results of IR-corrected cyclic voltammetry (CV) curves obtained in 1 M KOH solution show that the superaerophobic heterostructure presents an overpotential of 233 mV at the current density of 10 mA cm^{-2}... nodes.characterization_summary: As-deposited coating is ~500 nm thick with rough surface; after 30 h OER, ~100 nm self-reconstruction layer forms with flat surface.
nodes.evidence_snippet: As shown in Fig. 1b, the as-deposited coating is ∼500 nm thick. Fig. 1c presents that the coating uniformly grows on the nickel foam with a rough surface ... Aer the 30 h OER measurements, a self-construction layer (∼100 nm) forms on the coating (Fig. 1d) with the surface becoming at (Fig. 1e).

nodes.characterization_summary: XRD shows diffraction peaks at 41.8°, 42.8°, 43.6°, 45.2°, 46°, 46.6°, 50.5° and 52.7° indexed to (231), (330), (112), (240), (202), (141), (222) and (132) planes of Ni3P3; no Fe-related peaks detected; no obvious change after 30 h OER.
nodes.evidence_snippet: As shown in Fig. 1f, the X-ray diffraction (XRD) pattern of the powder sample scratched from the nickel foam exhibits diffraction peaks at 41.8°, 42.8°, 43.6°, 45.2°, 46°, 46.6°, 50.5° and 52.7°, which could be indexed to the (231), (330), (112), (240), (202), (141), (222) and (132) planes of Ni3P3, respectively. No Fe-related diffraction peaks are detected ... Aer 30 h OER measurements, no obvious change in the XRD pattern is found.

nodes.characterization_summary: Ni 2p3/2: metallic Ni at 852.57 eV, Ni^{x+} at 855.66 eV, satellite at 860.63 eV; after 30 h OER intensity of metallic Ni decreases at 852.7 eV while Ni^{x+} and satellite increase with positive shift. Fe 2p3/2: metallic Fe at 706.8 eV, Fe^{3+} at 712.6 eV; after OER metallic Fe decreases, Fe^{3+} increases.
nodes.evidence_snippet: As shown in X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy (XPS) spectra in Fig. 1g and h, a peak at 852.57 eV in the Ni XPS spectrum of (Ni1-xFex)3P could be indexed to the 2p3/2 region of metallic Ni, while the other two peaks at 855.66 eV and 860.63 eV in the 2p3/2 region should correspond to the Ni^{x+} and the shakeup satellite (sat.) peaks, respectively ... Aer 30 h measurements, the intensity of the metallic Ni (852.7 eV) greatly decreases, and the Ni^{x+} peak and the satellite peak become intense ... The Fe XPS spectrum of (Ni1-xFex)3P in the 2p3/2 region (Fig. 1h) shows two peaks at 706.8 eV and 712.6 eV, which correspond to the metallic Fe and Fe^{3+}, respectively.

nodes.characterization_summary: Single-crystal feature with ~500 nm grain size; after 30 h OER, amorphous self-reconstruction layer (~100 nm) forms on crystalline (Ni1-xFex)3P core.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The TEM image in Fig. 2a and the corresponding selected-area electron diffraction (SAED) pattern in Fig. 2c exhibit an obvious single-crystal feature of (Ni1-xFex)3P with a grain size of ∼500 nm. The high-resolution TEM (HRTEM) image in Fig. 2b shows a lattice distance of 0.217 nm ... Aer 30 h OER measurements, a self-construction layer is found on the surface (Fig. 2g).

nodes.characterization_summary: Lattice distance of 0.217 nm indexed to (231) plane of (Ni1-xFex)3P before OER; after 30 h OER, HRTEM shows crystalline (231) plane region and adjacent amorphous self-reconstruction layer.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The high-resolution TEM (HRTEM) image in Fig. 2b shows a lattice distance of 0.217 nm, which could be indexed to the (231) plane of (Ni1-xFex)3P ... The HRTEM image (Fig. 2h) presents two clearly divided parts. The part with lattice fringes is indexed to the (231) plane of (Ni1-xFex)3P, the other part without lattice fringes corresponds to the amorphous self-construction layer.

nodes.characterization_summary: Single-crystal feature of (Ni1-xFex)3P before and after 30 h OER measurements, confirming amorphous nature of self-reconstruction layer.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The corresponding selected-area electron diffraction (SAED) pattern in Fig. 2c exhibit an obvious single-crystal feature of (Ni1-xFex)3P ... The SAED pattern in Fig. 2i still shows an obvious single-crystal feature of (Ni1-xFex)3P, further proving the amorphous nature of the self-construction layer.

nodes.characterization_summary: Before OER: uniform Ni, Fe, P distribution, Fe/Ni=12.99%, P/Ni=37.96%; after 30 h OER: Fe/Ni decreases to 8.83%, P/Ni to 35.83%; self-reconstruction layer shows only Ni signal.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The corresponding energy dispersive spectra (EDS) in Fig. 2d–f show that the Ni, Fe and P elements are uniformly distributed, and the Fe/Ni ratio is 12.99%, while the P/Ni ratio is 37.96% (Table S2†) ... The EDS mapping images (Fig. 2j–l) exhibit a clear boundary ... The Fe/Ni ratio decreases to 8.83%, while the P/Ni ratio decreases to 35.83%.

nodes.characterization_summary: Peak of –OH groups greatly enhanced after OER measurements, attributed to generation of (NiFe)OOH–P.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The FTIR spectra in Fig. S2a† present that the peak of –OH groups is greatly enhanced aer the measurements, which could be attributed to the generation of (NiFe)OOH–P during the OER.

nodes.characterization_summary: After 30 h test, Raman peaks at 463.1 and 559.7 cm⁻¹ attributed to eg bending and A1g stretching vibrations of Ni–O in NiOOH; intensity ratio I463.1/I559.7 decreases in (NiFe)OOH–P.
nodes.evidence_snippet: For the sample aer the 30 h test, the Raman peaks at 463.1 and 559.7 cm⁻¹ are attributed to the eg bending vibration and the A1g stretching vibration of Ni–O in NiOOH. For the sample with a large amount of Fe retained in the selfconstruction layer, the intensity ratio (I463.1/I559.7) obviously decreases in the (NiFe)OOH–P.

nodes.characterization_summary: ICP-MS shows low Fe & P dissolution from intact catalyst (green lines); significantly higher Fe & P leaching after surface etching of self-reconstruction layer (blue lines), proving protective effect.
nodes.evidence_snippet: ICP-MS measurements for (c) Fe and (d) P concentrations in the electrolyte during the OER test at the current density of 100 mA cm⁻² ... only small amounts of Fe & P dissolve into the electrolyte (green lines in Fig. 3c and d). Aer etching part of self-reconstruction layer ... The etched sample (Fig. 3b) leached more Fe & P in the electrolyte compared to the sample aer 30 h measurements (blue lines in Fig. 3c and d).
